summary.text: The Dera, called Kanakuru by others, are the main indigenous people of Shelleng LGA in Adamawa State. Dera is a West Chadic language.

areas.note: Kanakuru 31% and Hausa 35% of homes surveyed. Share from a 2022-23 survey of displaced people quoted by Wikipedia, not a census.
